claim: A campaign ad video for John Cornyn says that his plan would guarantee insurers must sell plans to any patient with preexisting conditions and will be covered in his plan.
justification: High-confidence evidence from the retrieval-based fact-check corroborates that John Cornyn's 2020 campaign published the 'Cornyn Guaranteed Coverage Act' mandating insurers sell plans to all patients with preexisting conditions and that the campaign ad stated the plan would strengthen protections for preexisting conditions, aligning with the claim. Low-confidence items, such as the specific video wording and details about legal mechanisms, are discounted due to lack of corroboration.
